text: 深交所：本周对114起证券异常交易行为采取了自律监管措施，涉及盘中拉抬打压、虚假申报等异常交易情形；共对6起上市公司重大事项进行核查，并上报证监会1起涉嫌违法违规案件线索
text_en: Shenzhen Stock Exchange: This week it took self-regulatory measures against 114 cases of abnormal securities trading, involving intraday ramping and suppression, false declarations and other abnormal trading situations; it conducted verifications on 6 major matters of listed companies and reported 1 suspected illegal or irregular case lead to the CSRC
